summary: Russian forces have liberated villages in DPR and destroyed Ukrainian drones and a MiG-29. Ballistic missile threats persist across multiple regions, including Kharkiv and Kyiv. Ukrainian military returns include 103 soldiers from Russian captivity.
key_points: Russian army liberated Orekhovtka and Krasnopollye in DPR and shot down 1,671 Ukrainian drones and a MiG-29 (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32548).
Ballistic missile threats reported in Kharkiv, Kyiv, and Dnipro regions (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/70421, @mon1tor_ua/70411, @mon1tor_ua/70422).
Russian troops reported to have liberated Vodiane in DNR (Source: @tass_agency/391043).
Ukrainian military returned 103 soldiers from Russian captivity, including defenders from Mariupol and Kharkiv (Source: @UkraineNow/83528).
Russian strikes caused significant financial losses for Ukrainian companies, equating to annual GDP (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32571).
Khmara appointed as acting Minister of Defense, raising questions about political control (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32560).
Ballistic missile threats escalated with reports of Iskander-M rocket launches (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70419).

The destruction of drones and aircraft suggests attempts to degrade Ukrainian air defenses. Financial strain on Ukrainian companies may limit their ability to sustain operations.
